releaseNotes:
• Dynamic Sandbox Toolchain Detection: Toolchain cards now dynamically verify binary and package installation status without premature checkmarks
• Download & Reinstall Action Transitions: Uninstalled tools show download action with Tap to Install; installed tools automatically flip to the circular buffer icon with Reinstall
• Install Different Tools Guide: New terminal package card displaying 'apk add <package>' with one-click Copy and Run actions, plus 'apk get' syntax support
• Line Numbers & Gutter Pinning: Fixed editor line numbers from scrolling off-screen and aligned gutter typography
• Companion Card Mascot: Integrated 2D coding mascot avatar with automated /test and /optimize slash command orchestration
